name: Tata Scholarship at Cornell University
eligibility_criteria: Must be an Indian citizen, accepted for undergraduate admission to Cornell, and eligible for need-based financial aid.
award_value: Full tuition and living expenses for up to 8 semesters.

name: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: International student, nominated by their school. Outstanding academic achievement and creativity. Recognized as leaders within their school.
award_value: Tuition, books, incidental fees, and full residence support for 4 years.

name: Reach Oxford Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: Students from low-income countries who cannot study for a degree in their own countries for political or financial reasons. Must hold an offer from Oxford.
award_value: Course fees, a grant for living costs, and one return air fare per year.

name: Karsh International Scholarship
eligibility_criteria: International students demonstrating strong academic preparation and documented need for financial aid.
award_value: Full tuition, room and board, mandatory fees, demonstrated need, plus 3 summers of funding for research/internships.

name: Reliance Foundation Undergraduate Scholarships
eligibility_criteria: Indian students enrolled in 1st year of UG courses. Must have passed Class 12 with minimum 60%. Household income < Rs. 15 Lakh.
award_value: Up to Rs. 2 Lakhs over the duration of the degree.
